function: Learned joint power control and precoding for cell-free massive MIMO APs, maximizing sum spectral efficiency, with learned pruning of weak AP-UE links to cut complexity (p. 1-3).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO: power control L=9 APs with 8 antennas, K=8 single-antenna UEs; precoding K=4 UEs, Nt=16 antennas; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 2-3).
method: Sparse multi-dimensional GNN: learnable sigmoid adjacency and threshold mask prune weak links; power-control and precoding heads; end-to-end SE-maximizing loss (unsupervised in effect, not named) (p. 3).
data_channel: Simulated: Rayleigh fading with large-scale fading -30.5-36.7log10(d) for power control; SV model (4 clusters, 5 rays, 10 degrees spread) for precoding; 10,000 training, 2,000 test samples (p. 3).
test_conditions: Train on 10,000 samples, test on 2,000 of the same simulated setting with perfect CSI; threshold tau swept 0.5-0.7; no other scenario tested (p. 3-4).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE algorithm; learned: baseline MDGNN [12] and attention-based MDGNN (A-MDGNN), compared on SE and computation time (p. 3-5).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (CDF, relative SE), computation time relative to MDGNN, sparsity, performance retention and their harmonic mean (p. 4-5).
complexity: Measured computation time for identical samples and hardware: SP-MDGNN 0.52 times MDGNN, 48% reduction (55% power control, 49% precoding); WMMSE 25.29 times (Fig. 5, p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 3: "channels modeled by Rayleigh fading and large-scale fading" with a path-loss formula, and "modeled by the SV model with Ncl = 4 clusters, Nray = 5 rays"; a custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 3: "Datasets include 10,000 training and 2,000 testing samples." Test samples come from the same simulated setting; no unseen scenario, antenna or user number is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare it with three methods under identical conditions: the baseline MDGNN, the attention-based MDGNN (A-MDGNN), and the WMMSE algorithm." SE is compared in Fig. 4 and Fig. 5(a).
q4_support: p. 5: "The computational complexity comparison presented here is based on measuring the computation time required to process an identical number of samples using the same hardware setup for each method."
q5_support: p. 3: "Datasets include 10,000 training and 2,000 testing samples." The data are simulated by the authors; no code or data link or availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3 (precoder and power control of cell-free APs). It is a correspondence but proposes and evaluates a method with results. q3 counted as met with WMMSE as the non-learned baseline and MDGNN [12] as an earlier published learned method, although MDGNN is also the non-sparse base of SP-MDGNN; reviewer to confirm. The conclusion claims robustness across network conditions (p. 5) but no such experiment is reported, so q2=0. Title and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2025.3585879 are on page 1; Figs. 3-5 were read on pages 4-5.
